narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the regulatory differences and safety considerations of skincare ampoules between Europe and Taiwan. It uses a conversational format between a creator and a professional to explain why glass ampoules are common in Europe but restricted in Taiwan, focusing on the medical-grade nature of the packaging and the safety of ingredients like sodium benzoate.
